Definition: {to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come}
BiblicalUsage: Yehab is the Aramaic word for giving, for putting something into another's hand. God gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who know understanding, and the letter to the king says toll and tribute were paid to the kings of Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives wisdom to the wise, and the kings who ruled beyond the river paid tribute to His people.
